content: Eleventy (11ty) 3.1.6 is the current release (npm registry verified 2026): requires Node 18+, MIT, zero JS emitted by default, includes/data/templates (Nunjucks, Liquid), fast builds for dozens of pages. Reviewed as one of the best Node SSGs for simplicity and stability (Sitepoint, CloudCannon, community threads). Recommended for a small multi-page content site that needs shared nav/includes but no framework JS.
